title: Permissions, limits and shutdown before the pilot
promise: Complete a verifiable project milestone and keep evidence that another person can inspect.
why: A working demo is only the start. The handoff requires evidence about data, permissions, failure recovery and usefulness in the actual task.

theory.title: Action map
theory.text: List read, write, send, publish and delete actions. Record the account, minimum permission, owner and approval mechanism.
theory.example: Every externally visible action has an owner and control.

theory.title: Try a forbidden action
theory.text: Using limited test credentials, request an action outside its permission. Verify denial at the service, not merely in the model response.
theory.example: A denial record and confirmation that nothing was created, sent or modified.

theory.title: Test limits and approval
theory.text: In a test environment, submit instructions to bypass approval or budget limits. Deny approval and confirm the destination stays unchanged.
theory.example: Hostile input, observed block and evidence of an unchanged destination.

theory.title: Rehearse shutdown
theory.text: Document and disable the test trigger. Send another event: it must cause no actions. Reactivate and verify one controlled run. Never copy secrets into the document.
theory.example: Tested shutdown and recovery procedure, owner and credential location without secret values.

errors.means: The result cannot yet be checked.
errors.fix: Run the case and save the observation; leave it pending if blocked.

cantDo: Certify tests that nobody ran or approve on behalf of another person
